  • Constructor Details

    • RankedHypothesis

      private RankedHypothesis(String id, String description, double netScore, double supportPoints, double contradictPoints, List<String> supportingSources, List<String> contradictingSources, String confidence, int rank)
      Create a ranked-hypothesis result.
      Parameters:
      id - hypothesis id
      description - hypothesis description
      netScore - supporting minus contradicting strength
      supportPoints - total supporting strength
      contradictPoints - total contradicting strength
      supportingSources - distinct source types that support the hypothesis
      contradictingSources - distinct source types that contradict the hypothesis
      confidence - the confidence label
      rank - 1-based rank (1 is best)
